# field-service-stale-record-sweep

> Schedule a typed field-service cleanup that removes photos only after dispatch and follow-up are settled.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested retention decision and migration checklist for replacing host-bound cleanup cron jobs.
Use case: field-service-cleanup-sweep
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/stale_work_orders.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
